By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. lsvp-tabs:ashbyhq:4adb8c6f-90ce-497e-8da.description: Tabs is the leading AI-native revenue platform for modern finance and accounting teams. Tabs agents automate the entire contract-to-cash lifecycle, including billing, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting, to help teams eliminate manual work and accelerate cash flow. High-growth companies like Cursor and Statsig rely on Tabs to generate invoices directly from contracts, reconcile payments in real time, and automate ASC 606 compliance. Founded in 2023, Tabs has raised over $91 million from Lightspeed Venture Partners https://lsvp.com, General Catalyst https://www.generalcatalyst.com, and Primary https://www.primary.vc. The team is headquartered in New York and brings deep expertise in finance and AI. ABOUT THE ROLE You’ll be the first Data Engineer at Tabs, building the core data infrastructure that powers our internal KPIs, customer insights, and our AI systems. Your initial mandate is to design and implement the foundational data platform around our core metrics, and set us up for long-term analytical scalability. This role is ideal for an engineer who has built a data platform end to end and wants ownership of the full data stack. You’re comfortable operating in ambiguity and focused on driving real business impact. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Design and implement our first scalable data warehouse/lakehouse to support KPIs. - Build and maintain reliable data pipelines (batch and/or streaming) from application databases and third-party tools. - Work with leadership to translate business metrics into concrete data models and schemas. - Define and own data modeling standards and best practices. - Implement monitoring, data quality checks, and observability around pipelines and core tables. - Enable BI and data analysts through well structured models and self-serve friendly datasets. - Document the data platform (lineage, definitions, contracts) and help establish a shared source of truth for metrics. EXPERIENCE - 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, ideally in a mid-stage startup. - Solid programming skills in Python. - Strong SQL skills and experience designing/data modeling for analytics - Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack, such as: - Warehouses: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, etc. - Orchestration/transformation: dbt, Airflow, Dagster, or similar. - Ingestion: Fivetran, Stitch, custom ingestion pipelines, etc. - Experience building and operating production-grade data pipelines (performance, reliability, cost-awareness). - Strong understanding of data quality, testing, and monitoring practices. - Comfort starting from a relatively greenfield environment and making pragmatic build vs. buy decisions. NICE TO HAVE - Experience supporting BI tools (Looker, Mode, Tableau, Metabase, etc) and designing semantic layers. - Experience in B2B SaaS, especially around revenue, usage, and customer health metrics. - Prior experience as an early data hire or working in a small or medium, fast-growing startup. PERKS AND BENEFITS (FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES) - Competitive compensation and equity - Unlimited PTO - Up to 100% employer covered monthly healthcare premium (medical, dental, vision) - Lunch provided via Sharebite, plus dinner for any later in office days. - Parental leave up to 12 weeks - Tax free commuter and parking benefits - Voluntary insurances (Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, Accident) - Employee Assistance Program (Rightway) - Free One Medical Membership - 401k Tabs is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome teammates of all identities and do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We’re committed to creating an environment where everyone can grow, contribute, and feel comfortable being themselves.

onepeak-elliptic:ashbyhq:d62e50bb-7126-4.description: What’s the role? Elliptic is looking for a Product Designer to join our product-engineering organisation who believes in a customer-needs-centric approach to product development. We believe that the fastest route to great products is to involve our customers in every stage of the process, listen to them with empathy, enabling us to fail quickly and cheaply, so that we can afford to fail and learn often. We want someone passionate about creating parts of a product suite customers love using by delighting them with tools designed to be simple to use, intuitive to learn and enable them to make powerful decisions for their business. We believe that the most innovative solutions arise from empowered and diverse cross-functional teams who are focused on creative problem-solving together. What will you do? - Join a cross-functional team and work in step with product people, engineers and the wider company to solve highly valued problems in the crypto industry. - Work alongside product to identify the right solution to client challenges - Validate and refine designs through user research and testing, iterating based on what you learn to deliver experiences that work for our users and drive business outcomes. - Be a part of our design team, working towards the best product experience, collaborating on a consistent design system and design principles, systematically capturing and sharing what you’ve learnt and supporting each other, and progress by quickly giving and receiving feedback. - Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and prepare high-fidelity, specified UI designs supporting the engineers during implementation. - Learn an exciting new industry and become an expert in it quickly by collaborating with a team with deep domain understanding. What impact will you make? - Be fully leading your design space with your cross-functional team. - Be end to end part of the research, design, build lifecycle, bringing to life solutions that solve meaningful problems for Elliptic’s customers. - Set the standard and shape how Product design practice happens at Elliptic with the support of your Design Lead, and in collaboration with Product Managers and Engineering - Contribute to roadmap prioritisation, championing (amongst other things) problem & opportunity validation and customer experience improvements You will be a great fit here if you: - Care about asking great questions - Have an innate and insatiable curiosity and are keen to learn lots of new skills in design and research - Have a pragmatic approach to finding the balance between the ideal and the possible - Are excited by the potential of AI tools and actively explore how they can enhance design and research workflows. You don't need to be an expert, but you're curious, experimentative, and always looking for smarter ways to work Our ideal candidate: - Has spent a few years embedded in cross-functional product teams, ideally designing and building B2B SaaS products, and has made some mistakes along the way. Mistakes that you are not worried to show us! - Is resident in the UK within commutable distance to London. We’re a hybrid team, and we love to get our teams together twice a week for some collaboration, discussions and the chance to eat together! We believe this balance of some regular facetime together but mostly remote gives our team the best of both worlds.
